CornerPoint.description: A corner: [x, y] or {x, y} in mm, or [x, y] where a coordinate is an expression over the design's parameters, such as ["w / 2", 5]: the corner is then fixed and follows the parameters; text naming no parameter, such as "5", is just that number, in the design's length unit (a JSON number is mm), and does not itself fix the corner. Not a point's id or a snap.

LengthExpr.description: A length: a number in the design's length unit, or an expression such as "w / 2" or "30 mm".

Point2.description: A sketch point in mm: [x, y] or {"x", "y"}.

SketchTarget.description: The sketch: its feature id or its name (default: the one being edited).

input.description:
Draw an axis-aligned rectangle from two opposite corners, its four corners rounded alike, as
one undo step.

connect.description:
Make a new point that lands exactly on an existing point (the origin too) coincident with
it. Default: true.

construction.description: Draw construction geometry, which is not part of a profile. Default: false.

p0.description: One corner of the rectangle before rounding, as `sketch.rectangle.two_point` takes it.

p1.description: The opposite corner. It must differ from `p0` in both x and y.

radius.description:
The corner radius, in mm: a number or an expression over the design's parameters. Positive
and less than half the shorter side. One radius dimension holds it; the other arcs are
equal to it.

sketch.description: The sketch to draw in: its feature id or name. Default: the one being edited.

input.title: RectRoundedParams

label: Rounded Rectangle

Created.description: What a command added to its sketch: the ids that the sketch has now and did not before.

constraints.description: Constraint ids, dimensions not among them.

wires.description: The ids of 3D curves, when the command made any.

RectSides.description: An axis-aligned rectangle's sides by place, as line ids.

arcs.description: The corner arcs: bottom-left, bottom-right, top-right, top-left.

centre.description: The point held at the midpoint of the construction diagonal.

constraints.description:
The ids of the constraints added: the rectangle's, then the fillet's (tangencies and the
arcs equal to the first).

created.description: Everything the call added to the sketch: `{points, curves, constraints, dimensions}`.

curves.description: The ids of the four sides, then the four corner arcs.

diagonal.description: The construction diagonal between opposite corner-arc centres.

param.description: The parameter that holds the corner radius.

param_warnings.description: In the warn parameter-check mode: what the call's parameters got wrong.

sides.description: The sides by place. They end at the arcs now; there are no sharp corners to name.

sketch.description: The sketch's solve after the rounding: `{solved, dof}`.

params: p0, p1: opposite corners [x,y] (a coordinate may be an expression over the design's parameters: the corner is fixed and follows them, as in `sketch.rectangle.two_point`; text naming no parameter, such as "5", is just that number, in the design's length unit (a JSON number is mm), and does not itself fix the corner); radius: expr (the corner radius, less than half the shorter side); construction?. A 2-point rectangle whose four corners are filleted alike: one radius dimension (`param`), the other arcs equal to it. Returns sides {bottom, right, top, left} (line ids) and arcs (the corner arcs: bottom-left, bottom-right, top-right, top-left), diagonal (construction, between the bottom-left and top-right arc centres) and centre (the point held at its midpoint); connect?: bool (default true: a new point landing exactly on an existing point, the origin too, is made coincident with it). Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)
